historical_quality.reason: Author's explicit research tolerance, not an official contest or team threshold. No Q2 fit has been evaluated when frozen.

gates.B1: Actual annual Mesa agents, queue, operations and feedback; mechanism ablations
gates.B2: Physical and financial conservation; constraints tested with hand-solvable counterexamples
gates.B3: Q2-specific substantive input review and pinned provenance, not Q1 permission inheritance
gates.B4: Multi-target calibration, already-seen holdout, simple baselines, alternative rules and equivalent candidates
gates.B5: 2024 initialization and 2025-2060 S0; all required national indicators and coherent net CO2 boundary
gates.B6: Executed GDP, cost decline and carbon price sensitivity; explicit assumptions and stability
gates.B7: Missing, invalid, unreviewed and tampered inputs; infeasible/failed solver; stale results rejected
gates.B8: Regression, audits, scanner, nine legacy input contracts, dependency installation and independent reproduction
gates.B9: Two other human reviewers approve the same final SHA; cannot self-certify

completion_rule: All B1-B8 require actual evidence. B9 is external review. No synthetic fixture or missing national target can satisfy B4/B5.
